items.title: Jack Teagarden Interview, 1959-10-30
items.q: when I got to New York, he had just gotten up there and he was working with Freddie Rich

ctx.x: And he was in Streetport. And, and, they just started out, you know, in a couple of old Ford cars. They went to the west coast and back. They just work enough to get gasoline. They would just turn the country. And, when I got to New York, he had just gotten up there and he was working with Freddie Rich. and then the, I got him a job with Benny Pollack. Benny Pollack was gonna, stand in front of the baton, you know, in the hotel. And, he was going to Benny Pollack.
That's where he made his name.
